# Pinned common recipe advancement fixtures

These three JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes

`basalt_blast_furnace.json` is under `building_blocks/common/`, and the two
Cheese recipes are under `food/common/`. `sha256.json` records source bytes.
Native adaptations change only recipe IDs and the recipe-unlocked predicate
field.
